description: This is a PHP source file defining the Marketing model class within the Opencart Catalog module, which interacts with marketing-related data such as retrieving marketing details by code and adding reports.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Represents the Marketing model in the Opencart Catalog module, providing methods to access marketing data and report interactions.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Fetches a marketing record from the database matching the specified code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Inserts a new marketing report entry with the specified marketing ID, IP, country, and current date.
